groups.title: Testing in Laravel
groups.question: You are writing tests for a Laravel API where tests sometimes pass or fail depending on the order they run. Explain how you would write and isolate them.

followUps.PHPUnit Feature Tests vs Unit Tests: When would you write a feature test and when a unit test?
followUps.Database Testing with RefreshDatabase an: How does RefreshDatabase keep tests independent?

evidence.text: Feature tests boot the app and test full HTTP requests.
Unit tests check isolated classes without the framework.
Feature tests catch wiring bugs; unit tests are faster for pure logic.

notEnough: Only saying there are two kinds.

evidence.text: RefreshDatabase resets the database state between tests.
It usually wraps each test in a transaction that is rolled back.
Tests no longer depend on what other tests left behind.

notEnough: Only saying it refreshes the database.

groups.title: Mocking and Faking in Laravel
groups.question: Running your tests sends real emails and real payment calls. Explain how you would fake these in Laravel tests.

followUps.Mail::fake() and Queue::fake() for Side: What do Mail::fake and Queue::fake do?
followUps.Mockery and Service Container Substituti: How do you replace a payment service with a mock in a test?

evidence.text: Fakes replace real senders and dispatchers with in-memory recorders.
Nothing is actually sent or queued.
Tests assert that the right mail or job was sent.
Mockery creates a mock object with expectations.
Laravel's mock helper binds it in the container for the test.
Code that resolves the service gets the mock instead of the real one.

groups.title: Laravel Forge Deployment
groups.question: Your deploys briefly break the site while files update, and the production .env file is in the repository. Explain how you would deploy safely.

followUps.Zero-Downtime Deploys with Forge and Env: How do zero-downtime deploys switch to the new release?

evidence.text: Each release is prepared in a new folder.
Dependencies are installed and migrations run before switching.
A symlink is switched to the new release only after all steps succeed.

notEnough: Only saying Envoyer deploys without downtime.

evidence.text: Secrets are set on the server or in the hosting tool.
.env files with real secrets are never committed.
Committed secrets are exposed to anyone with repository access, even after deletion.

groups.title: CI/CD and Automated Quality Gates
groups.question: Bugs that a test or type checker would have caught keep reaching production. Explain how you would set up automated checks.

followUps.Running PHPUnit in CI with GitHub Action: What should a GitHub Actions workflow for Laravel do?
followUps.PHP Static Analysis with PHPStan or Lara: What does Larastan catch that tests might miss?

evidence.text: It sets up the right PHP version and installs dependencies.
It provides a real test database.
It runs the test suite on every pull request.
Larastan analyses code without running it.
It catches type mismatches, undefined properties and wrong method calls.
Its strictness level can be raised over time.

notEnough: Only saying it is a static analyser.
